text.p: Constellation Capital Partners LLC's II Acquisition Corp said Thursday it is launching its tender offer for all outstanding shares of common stock of Imo Industries Inc.
The tender offer is at a price of $7.05 per share.
The company said Imo and II Acquisition Corp entered into a definitive share purchase agreement on July 25 after Imo ended its merger agreement with United Dominion Industries Ltd.
United Dominion ended both its tender offer for the common stock of Imo and for certain notes issued by Imo on July 29.
The more than 80 percent of Imo's common stock most be tendered as a condition of the offer. Any shares not purchased in the tender offer will remain outstanding.
The tender offer will expire August 27.
Constellation Capital Partners LLC is a private equity firm based in Richmond, Virginia.
Imo's stock was trading at around 6 7/8, up 01/16.
